test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

_ V J R W B _ _ R W B V L _ _ B V _ _ W

options.text: B V K R W M R
A V K R W M R
A W K R X N R
B W K R W M R

solution:
**Given :** _ V J R W B _ _ R W B V L _ _ B V _ _ W 

By checking options :

 
• B V K R W M R → __**B**__ V J R W B __**V**__ __**K**__ R W B V L __**R**__ __**W**__ B V __**M**__ __**R**__ W → (It follows the pattern of : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0826b646b9a435a4e442bda0585512ca65ffe5b24d060620474e1e6881b0870e.png] 
 
• A V K R W M R → **__A__** V J R W B __V__ __K__ R W B V L __R__ __W__ B V __M__ __R__ W → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• A W K R X N R → **__A__** V J R W B **__W__** __K__ R W B V L __R__ **__X__** B V **__N__** __R__ W → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• B W K R W M R → __B__ V J R W B **__W__** __K__ R W B V L __R__ __W__ B V __M__ __R__ W → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of "__B__ V J R W - B __V__ __K__ R W - B V L __R__ __W__ - B V __M__ __R__ W"

Hence, "**B V K R W M R**" is the correct answer.
